app.name: LEADOS
app.tagline: One operating picture for people leadership, in every language your org speaks.

auth.signInSubtitle: Choose a demo account to explore a role and org.

onboarding.bannerBody: {completed} of {total} setup steps done. Sample data is on — remove it any time.
onboarding.wizard.title: Set up your organization
onboarding.wizard.step1.title: Organization profile
onboarding.wizard.step1.body: Name, logo and accent color used across LEADOS.
onboarding.wizard.step2.title: Terminology
onboarding.wizard.step2.body: Choose the word your org uses for a group of people.
onboarding.wizard.step3.title: Domains & roles
onboarding.wizard.step3.body: Allowed email domains and the roles you plan to use.
onboarding.wizard.step4.title: Sample data
onboarding.wizard.step4.body: Start with clearly labeled synthetic data you can remove in one click.
onboarding.emptyState.title: Nothing here yet
onboarding.emptyState.body: {view} will fill in once your team adds data — or add sample data to see how it works.
onboarding.removeSample.confirm: Remove all sample data for this organization?
onboarding.whatIsThisBody.now: Now is your daily operating view: the highest-priority briefings and findings across your org, scoped to what you're allowed to see.
onboarding.whatIsThisBody.subjects: This is the roster of people your role can see, with their current risk signal.
onboarding.whatIsThisBody.briefings: Briefings are short, generated summaries about a person or team, grounded in findings.
onboarding.whatIsThisBody.playbooks: Playbooks are suggested next actions tied to a finding or briefing.
onboarding.progressive.locked: Unlocks after you use {feature} a few times
onboarding.progressive.unlockedToast: New: {feature} is now available from the nav.
